responsibility: This machine-description fragment implements the core scalable-vector instruction patterns for AArch64 SVE. It provides the RTL expanders and insn definitions for scalable vector and predicate moves, contiguous and gather memory operations, predicated arithmetic, comparisons, reductions, permutes, conversions, counting operations, FFR handling, and many other VL-agnostic SVE instructions, forming the backend pattern layer consumed by vectorization, generic expansion, and the SVE builtin framework.
